_meta.status: Experiment on branch data-lab, not merged into the pipeline.

envelope.ambient_oxygen: o2_pct recorded and o2_basis equal to 'ambient' (the rule of match_environments in pipeline/run.py: any other basis is marked not_ambient); the numbers of counted tests left out because o2_pct is empty and because o2_basis is not 'ambient' are reported per need (excluded_o2_not_recorded, excluded_basis_not_ambient)
envelope.counted_tests: need_tests.csv rows with objective_link equal to 'stated'
envelope.degenerate_hull: fewer than 3 non-collinear distinct points: hull kind 'point' or 'segment', reported as 'no area'; inside is true only where the nominal point coincides with the point or lies on the segment
envelope.flagged_values: a value whose test carries a flag on that axis in the 'flags' column of tests.csv (for example o2_pct:approximate_in_source, o2_pct:range_in_source_start_value_named_in_publication) is used as the number held in tests.csv, like every other value, and is not left out; per need and axis, every counted test with such a flag is listed with its flags and o2_range_as_written, and min, max, nearest and each Pareto test give the number of flagged tests at that value
envelope.gap_sign: gap = nearest recorded value minus nominal value; positive means the nearest recorded value is above the nominal value; 0 means a test has exactly the nominal value; where two recorded values are equally near (one above, one below), both are listed
envelope.gravity: count of tests whose gravity_level string equals the scenario's gravity_level string; a scenario with gravity_level null sets none; where gravity_level of every test used is a table constant of the team's source mapping, the count equals the number of tests of tables mapped to that level and carries no information beyond that mapping
envelope.hull: convex hull of the distinct recorded (o2_pct, pressure_kpa) points, monotone chain, exact rational arithmetic, no tolerance
envelope.hull_boundary: a point on an edge or a vertex of the hull is reported as position 'boundary' and counted as inside
envelope.nearest_per_axis: the nearest recorded value of each axis is taken over that axis alone; the two axes can have their nearest value in different tests, and neither need be a test of the Pareto set: they are separate answers
envelope.no_hull: where no counted test records both values, hull kind is 'none', position is 'no hull' and inside is null (no position is defined)
envelope.nominal_rounding: h = half a unit of the last digit written for the nominal value in scenarios.json (70.3 gives 0.05; 21.0 gives 0.05); a gap or Pareto delta with absolute value below h is marked below_nominal_rounding; the 4 corners (nominal +- h on each axis) are placed relative to the hull like the nominal point and the number inside is reported, so a reader sees whether the position changes within the written rounding of the nominal
envelope.notes_per_need: every per-need sentence that applies is shown (no_tests where no counted test has ambient oxygen, no_nominal where the scenario has no nominal point); there is no precedence
envelope.number_reading: every cell and every spec number is read as the exact decimal it is written as (Python fractions.Fraction of the written string); differences are exact. The cells are the pipeline's standardized values: where a source column has another unit, the pipeline multiplied the cell by a unit factor of pipeline/spec/sources.json and rounded the product to 4 decimals (rule 'number' of pipeline/rules.py); the factor of every source column used is copied under 'conversions'. The nominal values are read as written in scenarios.json and are themselves rounded figures: see 'nominal_rounding'
envelope.pareto: a test is listed when no other test of the set has |delta o2_pct| <= its |delta o2_pct| and |delta pressure_kpa| <= its |delta pressure_kpa| with at least one of the two strictly smaller; deltas = test value minus nominal value; no combined distance, no weight, no scaling; tests with identical deltas are all listed; dominance is decided per axis, so a change of unit on either axis does not change the set
envelope.pooling: the hull and the Pareto set pool every counted test with ambient oxygen and pressure both recorded, whatever its fuel, flow, geometry or investigation; the tests pooled are reported per investigation_id, fuel_phase and sample_geometry (joint.composition) and in the summary table
envelope.ranges: the in_range rule of pipeline/run.py (RANGE_DEFAULTS: min inclusive, max exclusive unless stated) applied to the scenario's ranges; a range the scenario does not set is reported as not set; the joint count requires oxygen and pressure both inside and is asserted equal to tests_atmosphere of scenario_needs.csv
envelope.ranges_not_on_axes: a scenario range of a variable that is not one of 'axes' (flow_cms for the ISS) is printed with 'not applied' and enters no count
envelope.scenarios_without_nominal: a scenario whose nominal is empty gets no nominal-point numbers; its ranges are reported where set

order_changes.classes: for materials a, b and condition columns c1, c2: s1 = sign(a[c1] - b[c1]), s2 = sign(a[c2] - b[c2]); concordant if s1 = s2 != 0; discordant if s1 = -s2 != 0; tied_first_column_only if s1 = 0 and s2 != 0 (T_x); tied_second_column_only if s2 = 0 and s1 != 0 (T_y); tied_both_columns if both are 0. Concordant, discordant, tie, T_x and T_y as defined on the NIST Dataplot KENDALLS TAU page; tied_both_columns is the remaining class and enters neither T_x nor T_y
order_changes.column_pairs: every unordered pair of condition columns, in the column order of the spec
order_changes.criterion: each condition column carries the criterion named in the spec; a column pair is marked same criterion yes or no; pairs with different criteria are counted like all others and marked
order_changes.held: where the item holds a per-material condition (OF2012: test pressure), each class count is also given for the pairs whose held values differ
order_changes.kendall_tau_b: tau_b = (N_c - N_d) / sqrt((N_c + N_d + T_x)(N_c + N_d + T_y)) as defined on the NIST Dataplot KENDALLS TAU page (https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/software/dataplot/refman2/auxillar/kendell.htm); N_c = concordant pairs, N_d = discordant pairs, T_x, T_y = pairs tied in one column only; the script stops if the denominator differs from (n_0 - n_1)(n_0 - n_2); given exactly as numerator and the integer under the square root, and as a decimal rounded half-even to 'tau_b_digits' digits; undefined where the square root is 0
order_changes.material_pairs: every unordered pair of materials, in the row order of the item
order_changes.values: values are read as printed in the reference item's 'values' (exact decimals; JSON numbers read as decimal strings), no tolerance

search.rule: every reference item with a 'values' field is looked at; a table qualifies with at least 3 materials (rows) and at least 2 condition columns holding the same quantity. Every item with 'values' that is not in 'tables' must be listed here with a reason, or the script stops.

what_each_number_is.axes.flagged_tests: Counted tests with a flag on the axis in tests.csv, with the flags and o2_range_as_written; min, max and nearest carry flagged_tests_at_value.
what_each_number_is.axes.min, axes.max: Smallest and largest recorded value of the axis over those tests.
what_each_number_is.axes.nearest: The recorded value(s) closest to the nominal value on that axis alone, the gap (value minus nominal) and the number of tests at that value.
what_each_number_is.axes.nearest.below_nominal_rounding: Whether |gap| is smaller than half a unit of the last digit written for the nominal value.
what_each_number_is.axes.tests_recorded: Of the tests with ambient oxygen, the number with the axis (o2_pct or pressure_kpa) recorded.
what_each_number_is.conversions: Per axis and source of the counted tests: the source column, the pipeline rule and its parameters (unit factor) from sources.json.
what_each_number_is.counted_tests: Number of tests of need_tests.csv with objective_link 'stated' for the need.
what_each_number_is.counted_tests_with_ambient_oxygen: Of those, the tests with o2_pct recorded and o2_basis 'ambient'.
what_each_number_is.excluded_o2_not_recorded, excluded_basis: Counted tests left out because o2_pct is empty, and because o2_basis is not 'ambient'.
what_each_number_is.governed_by: Every output carries a 'governed_by' block: per decision point of pipeline/lab/model_map.json, the governing model key, source title, URL and opened_by, or 'team rule, no established model found'. Envelope and order fields carry the short label (point: model key or 'team rule') next to the number.
what_each_number_is.gravity.*: Number of tests whose gravity_level equals the scenario's, and where gravity_level in tests.csv comes from.
what_each_number_is.joint.composition: Number of pooled tests per investigation_id, fuel_phase and sample_geometry.
what_each_number_is.joint.hull_kind, joint.hull_vertices_ccw: Convex hull of those points: 'area', 'segment', 'point' or 'none', with its vertices counter-clockwise.
what_each_number_is.joint.nearest_tests_pareto: Tests not dominated in (|delta o2_pct|, |delta pressure_kpa|), each with both deltas and its source file and row.
what_each_number_is.joint.nominal_position, joint.nominal_in: 'interior', 'boundary', 'outside' or 'no hull' of the nominal point relative to the hull; boundary counts as inside; inside is null where there is no hull.
what_each_number_is.joint.rounding_box_corners_inside: Of the 4 corners nominal +- h (h = half a unit of the last written digit, per axis), the number inside the hull.
what_each_number_is.joint.tests_with_both_recorded, joint.di: Tests with ambient oxygen and pressure both recorded, and the number of distinct (o2_pct, pressure_kpa) points among them.
what_each_number_is.order.counts: For one table, one quantity and one pair of condition columns: the number of material pairs in each class (concordant, discordant, tied_first_column_only, tied_second_column_only, tied_both_columns; terms of the NIST Dataplot KENDALLS TAU page, the last is the remaining class).
what_each_number_is.order.counts_held_differs: The same class counts restricted to material pairs whose held condition (test pressure) differs.
what_each_number_is.order.discordant_and_tied_one_column_pai: Every material pair that is discordant or tied in one column only, with the four printed values.
what_each_number_is.order.kendall_tau_b: Kendall tau-b of the two columns over all material pairs as defined on the NIST Dataplot KENDALLS TAU page, as numerator, integer under the square root and rounded decimal.
what_each_number_is.order.same_criterion: Whether the two condition columns carry the same criterion (spec).
what_each_number_is.ranges.*: Number of tests inside the scenario's oxygen range, inside its pressure range, and inside both; the last equals tests_atmosphere of scenario_needs.csv (checked).

what_these_numbers_cannot_say: Whether a material burns, or how, at a scenario's nominal point: no outcome variable is read by the envelope numbers.
Anything about a point inside the hull beyond the existence of tests on several sides of it: no value is interpolated.
Anything about gravity levels other than the ones in tests.csv: every test there carries a gravity level that the team's source mapping sets as a constant per table.
Which of two materials is more flammable in a scenario: the order tables are normal-gravity or drop-tower results printed by the authors, at the printed conditions only.
Whether a difference of one printed unit is a real difference: the items state no measurement uncertainty or step size.
Whether the counted tests are the right tests for a need: that is the pipeline's linking rule (needs.json, stated_by), not arithmetic.
